p: Bitcoin steht bei 75.947 Dollar, +0,9 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -1,8 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.244 Dollar, +1,3 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,67 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,2 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 25 von 100.
8 Prozent der 303 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 15 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Die Mehrheit liegt unter ihrem Durchschnitt. In solchen Phasen sind Erholungen meist kurzlebig.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 36, also im mittleren Bereich.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 292,5 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 5,7 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 80,2 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (43,4 Milliarden Dollar), Base (5,8 Milliarden Dollar), Solana (5,2 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt Gaming mit +0,7 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 46 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist SocialFi mit -7,3 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 8 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben KAVA (78), JST (73), WIN (71).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: EOS +41,0 Prozent, AKE +17,2 Prozent, PIEVERSE +10,0 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei JST: Über beiden Durchschnitten, RSI 55 im gesunden Bereich. Trend ohne Übertreibung.
Beim Social Buzz führen INJ (97), AKE (96), LIT (82).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: RPL (76), NAVX (73), LDO (74), SYRUP (69).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 1 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um -2 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 75.097 Blöcke. also rund 522 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 31 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 40 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 4,90 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
news.z: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

news.t: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
news.z: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

news.t: Treasury cuts off MEXC Global over alleged $16 billion in transactions linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia
news.z: Treasury says it has severed MEXC Global from the U.S. after it allegedly supported $16 billion in transactions connected to Iran.

news.t: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
news.z: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

news.t: US Treasury walks back crypto surveillance ‘travel rule’ proposal
news.z: The Treasury Department has withdrawn a controversial proposal that would have expanded requirements for cryptocurrency transactions.

news.t: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
news.z: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

news.t: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
news.z: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

news.t: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
news.z: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

news.t: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
news.z: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

news.t: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
news.z: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.

news.t: Gnosis Pay data breach exposes customer info; funds unaffected
news.z: Gnosis Pay disclosed a data breach after unauthorized access to its legacy debit card system on Nov. 3. Customer funds were not affected.

news.t: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
news.z: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
news.z: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

news.t: Trump administration moves closer to allowing crypto in 401(k) retirement plans
news.z: A rule that would open up 401(k) retirement accounts to alternative assets, including cryptocurrencies, has landed at the White House.

news.t: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
news.z: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

news.z: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.
